description: This file defines the 'Education' display field class for reports in the OrangeHRM system. It extends ListableDisplayField and specifies methods for obtaining the Data Transfer Object class, entity aliases, and fields related to employee education data.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: Represents the Education display field for employee reports, providing DTO class info, entity aliases, and fields related to education data.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field, specifically for Education data.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity aliases used in queries for this display field, here returning 'education'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields ('employee.empNumber') used in the report for this display field.
